sources.title: Solar Pro 3 model specifications and version history
sources.evidence: Identifies the solar-pro3 alias, currently pointing to solar-pro3-260323, and original solar-pro3-260126 released January 26, 2026. Documents nominal 102B total / 12B active MoE, 128,000 context, reasoning and tool calling. Hosted and contracted on-premises access; scheduled retirement October 30, 2026 KST.

sources.title: Solar Pro 3: Better reasoning at production scale, January 26, 2026
sources.evidence: Dated launch announcement explicitly says Solar Pro 3 is available through Upstage Console APIs and partner services. Establishes public availability on January 26 rather than the later OpenRouter listing or March update. Describes reasoning and instruction following.

sources.title: Solar Pro 3: 2x Agentic Performance — What Changed, March 24, 2026
sources.evidence: Describes the March update to the Solar Pro series, specifically solar-pro3-260323. Reports 102B total and 12B activated per token in a MoE architecture, with SnapPO reinforcement learning. States that the model launched in January and links the separate Solar Open technical report for training-method background.

sources.title: Upstage AI Champion/Rookie competition presentation, slide 9
sources.publisher: Upstage, Seungwon Cheon / NFM center; hosted by AI Challenge 4 All
sources.evidence: Visually inspected cover attribution and slide 9. The Solar Pro 3 slide identifies January 2026 release, text-only modality and MoE architecture with 102.6B total / 12B active. Its heading also uses nominal 102B. This is an author-reported specification, not a reconciled checkpoint count. A nearby QR code recommends reading the Solar Open report; the parameter bullet is under the exact Solar Pro 3 heading.

sources.title: Solar Pro 3 endpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Direct endpoint JSON identifies Upstage as the provider, text input/output, 131,072 context, reasoning controls and tool parameters. This is the routed endpoint contract; the native Upstage documentation separately specifies 128,000. Provider creation timestamp is not used as model launch evidence.

sources.title: Terms of Service, Articles 7, 8 and 23
sources.evidence: Terms cover Solar LLM services, grant limited non-transferable service use, reserve intellectual property to Upstage and restrict unauthorized copying, redistribution and reverse engineering. Supports the descriptive proprietary classification for the hosted model, rather than an open-weight license.

sources.title: Solar Pro 3 tokenizer card and file listing
sources.evidence: The exact public repository is explicitly a tokenizer for solar-pro3. Its file listing contains tokenizer assets and no model checkpoint. Its Upstage Solar License metadata applies to this published tokenizer; it is not evidence that Solar Pro 3 model weights are released under that license.

sources.title: Upstage public model repository inventory
sources.evidence: Inspected the returned public organization inventory: Solar Pro 3 appears as solar-pro3-tokenizer; the separately released Solar Open checkpoints have different identities. No exact Solar Pro 3 weight repository was present in the returned inventory. Used with official distribution documentation, not as a standalone proof of licensing.

sources.title: Solar Open technical report linked by the Solar Pro 3 announcement
sources.evidence: Downloaded and searched the complete report, including architecture Table 2 and SnapPO training section. It specifies the distinct Solar Open model, not an exact Solar Pro 3 architecture column. Its layer counts, expert configuration and open-weight licensing are not transferred to Solar Pro 3.

sources.title: Solar Open 2 later model card
sources.evidence: Inspected the later card for exact Solar Pro 3 technical comparisons. It does not provide an exact Solar Pro 3 parameter or architecture column; no Solar Open 2 specifications are transferred to this model.

name.note: Exact name attached to the solar-pro3 API alias.

developer.note: Developer and presenter identify the model as Upstage Solar Pro 3.

family.note: Solar Pro series; distinct from the separately published Solar Open checkpoints.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit public availability found is the January 26 launch, matching the original version entry. March 23 is an alias update; the OpenRouter listing is later. Searches for earlier preview announcements did not establish an earlier date.

open_weights.note: Documented access is hosted API or contracted on-premises deployment. The public exact-model repository is tokenizer-only; neither it nor the separate Solar Open releases establishes public Solar Pro 3 weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted model under limited commercial service rights. Do not transfer the public tokenizer license or Solar Open checkpoint license to the closed model.

parameters_b.note: Developer presentation gives 102.6B under the exact Solar Pro 3 heading. Developer docs and announcement use nominal 102B. Preserve the more precise author-reported figure; this is not an independently counted checkpoint total or a value inferred from Solar Open.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal developer-reported active count per forward pass/token for the MoE model; distinct from total parameters.

architecture.note: Exact-model sources explicitly identify mixture-of-experts. Detailed Transformer layer and expert layouts in the separate Solar Open report are not transferred.

context_window.note: Use the native Upstage model page’s explicit 128,000-token limit. OpenRouter reports 131,072 for its Upstage route; retain this provider-contract difference in notes rather than silently treating both values as identical.

modalities.note: Exact Solar Pro 3 slide explicitly says text-only, corroborated by routed endpoint text-to-text metadata.

reasoning.note: Explicit reasoning mode and endpoint reasoning controls, rather than an inference from benchmark performance.

tool_call.note: Version documentation specifies function calling and parallel tool calls; endpoint exposes tools and tool_choice.

description.value: Upstage text-only mixture-of-experts model with reasoning and tool calling, supporting Korean, English and Japanese.
description.note: Replaces unsupported promotional flagship wording with documented modality, architecture, capabilities and languages.

patch.notes: Released January 26, 2026; the solar-pro3 alias now points to the March 23 update. Upstage reports 102B nominally, while its Solar Pro 3 presentation specifies 102.6B total and 12B active; these are author-reported counts, not an independently counted checkpoint. Native Upstage documentation specifies 128,000 context tokens; its OpenRouter route advertises 131,072. Public tokenizer assets do not constitute a weight release. Upstage schedules all Solar Pro 3 versions for retirement on October 30, 2026 KST.

summary: Confirmed January 26, 2026 public release and all 14 fields. Added author-reported 102.6B total, 12B active and MoE architecture, classified the hosted license as proprietary, replaced promotional description, and used native Upstage’s 128,000 context limit while preserving the OpenRouter 131,072 discrepancy. March alias update and planned retirement are recorded. Solar Open specifications and tokenizer licensing are not transferred.
